standard_prerequisites.name: The commutator quotient Lambda^natural is Lambda modulo the additive subgroup generated by commutators, so any element of the form ab - ba maps to zero
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the final sum vanish in Lambda^natural.

core_obligations: Expand (sum lambda_g g)(sum mu_g g) - (sum mu_g g)(sum lambda_g g) coefficientwise (proof lines 1633-1637): the coefficient of a basis element g is sum over g_1 g_2 = g of lambda_{g_1} mu_{g_2} - mu_{g_1} lambda_{g_2} (proof lines 1637-1641). For g = e the coefficient is sum_g (lambda_g mu_{g^{-1}} - mu_g lambda_{g^{-1}}), which after reindexing the second term is sum_g (lambda_g mu_{g^{-1}} - mu_{g^{-1}} lambda_g) (proof lines 1641-1644). Each summand is of the form xy - yx, so the whole sum vanishes in the commutator quotient Lambda^natural (proof lines 1644-1645). Hence the coefficient map factors through Lambda[G]^natural (proof lines 1631-1645).
proof_roadmap: Expand the commutator difference and extract the coefficient of e (proof lines 1633-1641).
Reindex and recognize the sum as a sum of commutators (proof lines 1641-1645).
